description: Long-value fixture: a long hyphenated legal name, three former names, a long multi-line address, and a long participant-written charge description, to prove the caption, the party block, the allegation container and the signature block wrap rather than truncate.

partyData.petitionerAddress: 0000 EXAMPLE MEADOW ROAD, APARTMENT 000, EXAMPLE VILLAGE OF EXAMPLETON, VT 00000-0000
partyData.otherNamesUsed: M. A. SAMPLE-EXAMPLE; MARIA ANTONIA DE LA SAMPLE; M. SAMPLE-TESTCASE

chargeData.chargeDescription: [PARTICIPANT'S OWN DESCRIPTION OF THE CHARGE, WRITTEN OUT AT LENGTH — A SINGLE COUNT DESCRIBED IN THE PARTICIPANT'S OWN WORDS ACROSS SEVERAL CLAUSES, INCLUDING HOW THEY UNDERSTOOD IT AT THE TIME AND HOW IT WAS DESCRIBED TO THEM WHEN THE DEFERRED SENTENCE AGREEMENT WAS ENTERED — NOT SUPPLIED, EDITED OR SUMMARISED BY LEGALEASE]
chargeData.disposition: deferred sentence agreement fulfilled; discharged from probation and adjudication of guilt struck

screeningAnswers.restitutionPaidInFull: yes — paid in full; [PARTICIPANT'S OWN DATE]
screeningAnswers.orderIssued: no — the record check still shows the case

eligibilityData.supportingDocumentNote: Participant-obtained. LegalEase does not obtain, receive or inspect them.

partyDataFieldNote: partyData uses the PleadingRenderInput field names petitionerName / petitionerAddress / otherNamesUsed. The role label for this track is set by presentation.movantRole in the config ('Requester'), not by the fixture key name.
identityFieldNote: caseData.docketNumber and caseData.countyName are the participant's own required screening answers and are deliberately left blank in the fixtures under the artifact convention. The rendered request cannot go out without them; they are supplied by the participant, never by LegalEase.
